page.content:
Northern and Southern pole peoples of waterbending.

How Water Tribes connects

  • Character: Katara — Katara is a waterbender of the Southern Water Tribe.
  • Character: Sokka — Sokka is a warrior of the Southern Water Tribe.
  • Location: Southern Water Tribe — The South is one of the Water Tribes.
  • Character: Korra — Korra is born to the Southern Water Tribe.

What is Water Tribes?

The Water Tribes are the polar nations Katara and Sokka come from — a reduced South and a fortified North — whose bending heals, freezes, and later bloodbends.

Key threads lead to Katara, Sokka, Southern Water Tribe and Korra.
